facts.fact: The Statistics from Space project, with Universidade Eduardo Mondlane, IFPRI and the University of Twente among the authors' affiliations, tested an Earth-observation crop-type mapping workflow in Mozambique and generated openly accessible crop type maps and statistics for Gaza, Manica and Zambezia for the 2024/25 season.

facts.fact: CGIAR says the Statistics from Space project, run with Eduardo Mondlane University and stakeholders including MADER and INE, piloted satellite time-series stratified crop sampling at 92 sites in Gaza province in the 2023-2024 season, and a 2024-06-18 workshop agreed to transfer the technology to local institutions.

FAO says a two-day online coaching on 19 and 20 August 2026 trained technicians of the National Irrigation Institute (INIR) on IPADT, a WaPOR-based remote-sensing dashboard of irrigation performance for the Lower Limpopo schemes (Chokwe, Xai-Xai); the next step is to support INIR in applying it to real management problems.
facts.system: IPADT (Irrigation Performance Assessment and Diagnostic Tool)
